claim: Do not test carry after ADD HL/DE/BC,A or LDWS: the book says ADD rr,A always clears it and LDWS has the flags of INC D, while docs/LEARNINGS.md and docs/NEXT_REGISTERS.md report board results that disagree with each other.
limit: Unresolved: the two board notes in the repository contradict one another, so one of them is misread; compare the result instead of testing the flag.

evidence.source: I. Novak, Unraveling the ZX Spectrum Next, Vol 1 (2026; core 3.03.03), chapter 2
evidence.text: ADD rr,A adds A unsigned, wraps past FFFF and clears carry even on a wrap, other flags kept; ADD rr,nn leaves every flag; LDWS takes the flags of INC D.
